track: The Agent That Can Explain Why
summary: Agents investigate why supplier shipments arrive after the committed date. A Skeptic agent re-queries Zetaris to verify every number the Analyst quotes and rejects suspects the data does not support, so managers act on the real cause instead of the usual suspects.

sponsor_tech.zetaris: Data layer. All queries (breakdowns, the Skeptic's independent recounts, baselines) run as SQL through the Zetaris REST API against the TPC-H dataset seeded in Zetaris. Adapter: src/adapters/zetaris.ts
sponsor_tech.meterless_engine: Markovian engine (own implementation, src/engines/markovian/). The whole investigation is one Markovian run: one hypothesis per chunk, only the COMPLETED/REMAINING/DECISIONS/CONTEXT carryover passes forward. Passes the official conformance suite 8/8: npm run test:markovian
sponsor_tech.meterless_nightshift: Primary AI provider for every agent model call (OpenAI-compatible Runtime, meterless-app/meterless-scope headers, model discovery via /v1/models). Client: src/adapters/nightshift.ts
sponsor_tech.nvidia: NVIDIA Nemotron models configured in Nightshift's Providers tab power the agents; the model that handled every call is logged per trace event

pre_existing_components: None. All code written during the build window (27-28 Oct 2026). Open-source dependencies: sql.js, tsx; vendored Meterless conformance runner (Apache-2.0).
